name: Levi
overview: Levi, the son of Jacob and Leah, is introduced as 'Joined,' reflecting his birth as the third son (Genesis 29:34, 35:23). Scripture highlights his fierce and violent nature alongside his brother Simeon, describing them as 'instruments of cruelty' and warning against joining their secret assemblies due to their anger that led to the killing of a man and the destruction of a wall (Genesis 49:5-6). Jacob's prophecy pronounces a curse on their fierce anger and cruel wrath, declaring that he will scatter them throughout Israel (Genesis 49:7). These verses collectively portray Levi as a figure associated with zealous and sometimes harsh actions within Israel's history.
